_doc: AI data changes. Entry: {"sheet":"constant","id":"AI_Army_StuckTime","path":["value"],"expected":5,"value":4,"why":"..."}. 'expected' is checked against vanilla; path indexes into the row (e.g. ["values",3,"val"] = Insane).

changes.why: Vanilla re-rolls the retreat ratio every tick in [0.5,0.8], so any fight below ~0.8 retreats within a second (6 vs 8 armies always ran). Fixed 0.65; tools/behave.py multiplies the fight balance by the terrain factor (own land 1.3, enemy land 0.8) before the check.
